notes.title: A new game coming soon!
notes.content:
[h1]A new game is being published soon![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42147170/59fa071c61ea6d875bdb371d17ce9b9f2ace490a.png[/img]
[h2]Some Synergy[/h2]
The new game is titled Some Synergy and will be released on August 5th, 2022. It is similar to, yet different from Past Synergy. While designing the game, I made sure to keep in mind the pros and cons of Past Synergy. Some issues I recognized with Past Synergy were
[list]
[*]It sucks
[*]Some levels are too difficult
[*]Later in the game, players get set roles (One player always gets the shield and the other player always gets the double jump)
[/list]
The new game still sucks and some levels are likely too difficult, but at least I think I addressed the 3rd point. Unlike Past Synergy, in which there were items, Some Synergy does not have them. Instead, it is the map itself that affects the players.

The game will be released on August 5th, 2022, but I plan on releasing the free demo for the game about a week before that time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42147170/aff5c45f45b16717cc4d4ce1801ab1a290405e07.png[/img]
Hope everyone looks forward to it, and as always...[h1]Thank you for all the support![/h1]

notes.title: Some news about Past Synergy
notes.content:
Hello everyone. It's been about 3 and a half months since Past Synergy was released and about 1 and a half month since the last update.

Since the last update, I have been studying much multiplayer programming and so on, but unfortunately I do not yet have enough knowledge to fully add an online mode mode for past synergy. I have learned enough to make a slow paced multiplayer game, but not enough to fast paced multiplayer game. Therefore, I will continue to learn multiplayer programming, but I do not expect it to be completed anytime soon.

notes.title: Upcoming: Online mode (possibly as a DLC) and new levels!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
It's been about a month since this game was published, and thank you for over 4000 people for playing this game.

Past Synergy will soon receive a big update.

TLDR:
Online mode (This might be a DLC, which might not be free)
Steam remote play will stay
New levels 16-20.

Online mode:
I wanted to make this feature ever since I began making this game, but didn't know enough about programming to make this feature, but after studying much, I am almost done making online mode now!
This feature might be added as a DLC (This might not be free since I don't want the server to be too crowded).
Whether this new feature is free or not, steam remote play will stay.

New levels 16-20.
This new levels will provide you and your friend with new challenges!

The new levels 16-20 are already created, but making the online mode is taking more than I expected, so the new levels might be added first.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42147170/59fa071c61ea6d875bdb371d17ce9b9f2ace490a.png[/img]

notes.title: Major Update: New levels and many improvements, but this game still sucks
notes.content:
Hello everybody!

Past Synergy has a new update. Here are the updates I made:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42147170/59fa071c61ea6d875bdb371d17ce9b9f2ace490a.png[/img]

5 new levels:
The new levels -11 to -15!
The new levels feature new challenges that will improve you and your friend's synergy!
To unlock the new levels, the previous levels need to be unlocked as well.

A new item!
Double Jump: When activated, if the other player is midair, the other player will jump again once in air.
TLDR: you can help the other player jump twice.

No story!
I've been thinking about this for a while, and decided that the story is unnecessary in this game. Therefore, when first entering the game, level 1 will not begin at the story, but will immediately start with level 1.
Similarly, level 10 has been adjusted so that it began at the second level 10 (if anyone noticed, clearing level 10 twice gave you a different ending) and skips the story.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42147170/aff5c45f45b16717cc4d4ce1801ab1a290405e07.png[/img]
Autosave!
The game will now save your progress each time you clear a level. Therefore, I got rid of the save game button.

Score Reset!
You can now reset scores in the PvP mode.


Level 1 adjustment:
The instructions about controls now include enter and space

Level 7 adjustment:
I forgot to change it from when I was trying few mechanics on this level, so changed it to what I was originally planning on.

Settings menu bug:
Fixed a bug where settings menu could not be opened multiple times.
